summary:
URGENT — PLATINUM WINDOW OPEN.
This patient carries TIER_1 biology (M2-dominated, mTOR-hyperactive) and is currently platinum-sensitive.
This is a time-sensitive intervention moment in HGSOC (RUO).
Internal cohort data: PLATINUM_WINDOW KM median OS ≈ 84.13 months (n=9, events=5) (95% CI lower bound 15.18; upper not estimable). Reference: TIER_1_TRIPLE raw median OS ≈ 25.0 months.
The window closes as stromal exclusion rises and/or platinum resistance emerges.
Recommended sequencing (hypothesis-generating): initiate Metformin now,
add Dupilumab at Week 2,
coordinate platinum rechallenge and consider checkpoint only after immune accessibility improves.
Do not treat this as clinical instruction; prospective validation required.

sequence: Start Metformin (metabolic reset; AMPK activation / mTOR suppression).
Add Dupilumab (IL-4/IL-13 axis blockade; M2 reset).
Platinum rechallenge *within metformin window* (mechanistic rationale: PMC9899624).
Introduce checkpoint inhibitor after immune accessibility improves.
recommendation.rationale: Exploit the platinum-sensitive window while executing metabolic + M2 reset.
